exposed_pad.note: 5-pin DBV SOT-23 package has no exposed thermal pad (RθJC(bot) = N/A, p.5; unlike 4-pin DQN X2SON which has a GND thermal pad).

pinout.name: IN

pinout.name: EN
pinout.description: Active-high enable (>= 0.9 V ON, <= 0.35 V OFF; NO internal pulldown—do not float; abs max capped at VIN + 0.3 V).

pinout.name: NC
pinout.description: No internal connection (check PCB wiring before swapping to Pin-4 BYP/NR/FB SOT-23-5 LDOs).

pinout.description: Fixed 3.3 V output with 120 Ohm active discharge ('P' suffix); abs max strictly 3.6 V; stable with >= 1 uF X5R/X7R ceramic cap.

vout_v.condition: Fixed 3.3 V active-discharge ('P') option in DBV SOT-23-5 (Active Production, marking '1CBT')

iq_typ_ua.condition: 34 uA typ / 60 uA max ground pin current at IOUT = 0 mA

min_cout_uf.table_ref: Section 8.1.1 Input and Output Capacitor Selection

en_abs_max_v.condition: EN abs max is strictly VIN + 0.3 V (5.8 V at VIN = 5.5 V; NOT 6 V independent of VIN—driving EN while VIN = 0 V violates Abs Max!)

design_gotchas.title: EN Abs Max Strictly Capped at VIN + 0.3 V & No Internal EN Pulldown (Unlike TLV755P / TLV757P)
design_gotchas.detail: Table 6.1 (p.5) limits VEN to -0.3 V to VIN + 0.3 V (rec op 0 to VIN), and Section 7.3.2 (p.14) confirms there is NO internal pulldown resistor on EN. Driving EN from an always-on 3.3 V GPIO before VIN rises forward-biases internal clamps—a hidden trap when replacing 6 V-EN-tolerant TLV75533PDBVR or TLV75733PDBVR.

design_gotchas.title: Ultra-Tight 3.6 V Abs Max Rating on VOUT (Cannot Survive 5 V Back-Feed or Mis-Wiring)
design_gotchas.detail: Unlike peer 5.5 V LDOs whose VOUT survives up to 6.0 V, TLV74333PDBVR restricts VOUT Abs Max to -0.3 V to 3.6 V (p.5) and has an unblocked PMOS body diode from OUT to IN (Sec. 7.3.3, p.14). Any 5 V bus short, programmer back-powering, or VIN collapse with a charged rail risks instant damage.

design_gotchas.title: High 228.4 °C/W DBV Thermal Resistance Restricts 5 V -> 3.3 V Full 300 mA Load
design_gotchas.detail: At JEDEC RθJA = 228.4 °C/W (p.5), 300 mA from 5.0 V to 3.3 V dissipates 0.51 W and produces ΔT = 116.5 °C (TJ = 141.5 °C at 25 °C ambient, exceeding the 125 °C continuous rating). Limit 5 V -> 3.3 V continuous current to ~200 mA at 25 °C (or ~170 mA at 85 °C with high-K copper, Fig. 31 p.17) or feed from a 3.8 V rail.

design_gotchas.title: Foldback Startup Limit (170 mA Typ) & 800 us Slow 3.3 V Startup Time
design_gotchas.detail: Short-circuit foldback reduces current to 170 mA typ when VOUT is near 0 V (p.7, p.14), which can prevent constant-current loads from rising into regulation unless enabled after VOUT settles. Also note 3.3 V startup time from EN is 800 us typ (3.2x slower than 1 V option's 250 us, p.7) and PSRR rolls off to 35 dB at 10 kHz.

typical_use_cases: Cost-optimized 300 mA 3.8 V–4.2 V Li-Ion to 3.3 V point-of-load LDO rails in standard SOT-23-5 footprints
DC-DC buck post-regulation (3.8 V -> 3.3 V) needing low 125 mV typ dropout, ±1.4% full-temp accuracy, and 120 Ohm active output discharge
Space-constrained consumer/WLAN modules replacing TLV73333PDBVR where 1 uF ceramic (or cap-less) stability and 0.1 uA shutdown are needed
engineering_summary: The Texas Instruments TLV74333PDBVR is a 300 mA, fixed 3.3 V (±1.0% @ 25°C, ±1.4% over -40°C..125°C), 34 uA IQ ceramic-stable LDO in a standard 5-pin DBV SOT-23-5 package (1=IN, 2=GND, 3=EN, 4=NC, 5=OUT) featuring 125 mV typ dropout at 300 mA and a 120 Ohm active discharge pulldown. Operating from 1.4 V to 5.5 V (6.0 V abs max), it is a popular low-cost peer to TLV73333PDBVR and TLV75533PDBVR, but engineers must watch its strict VOUT <= 3.6 V abs max, EN <= VIN + 0.3 V (no internal pulldown), unblocked reverse-current body diode, and 228.4 °C/W thermal limit.

300 DPI PNG Vision on p.6–7 confirmed ±1.0%/±1.4% accuracy, VDO=125 mV typ / 220 mV max (85°C) / 270 mV max (125°C) at 3.3 V/300 mA, IGND=34/60 uA, ISHDN=0.1/1 uA, Vn=120 uVRMS (@1.8 V), PSRR 68/35/28 dB (100 Hz/10 kHz/100 kHz; 50 dB @ 1 kHz p.1), tSTR=800 us (@3.3 V), 120 Ohm pulldown, ILIM=360–700 mA, and IOS=170 mA.
